candidates.source_name: Inspektorati i Punës i Republikës së Kosovës (Labour Inspectorate) — official site
candidates.why_relevant: Sole executive body supervising labour-relations and OSH law in Kosovo; receives and rules on individual and collective dismissal complaints (documented rulings against ProCredit Bank employees). Publishes notices, inspection campaign results, employer checklists and annual reports — the primary official channel where bank redundancies and wage disputes become visible before employers announce them.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of news/notice pages (?p= and ?page_id= paths) plus PDF harvest of annual reports; keyword filter on bank names and 'largim kolektiv', 'ankesë', 'shkelje'.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from investigative reporting
queries_used: Inspektorati i Punës Kosovë raporti vjetor inspektimi
Inspektorati i Punës Kosovë bankë largime kolektive

candidates.source_name: Inspektorati Qendror (Central Inspectorate) — cross-inspectorate reporting portal
candidates.why_relevant: Umbrella body that aggregates and publishes periodic (reportedly ~48-hour cycle) inspection statistics across inspectorates, including the Labour Inspectorate. Useful as a structured, higher-frequency pointer into inspection volumes and enforcement actions by sector.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled scrape of periodic inspection bulletins; extract sector breakdowns.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search snowball from Labour Inspectorate query
queries_used: Inspektorati i Punës Kosovë raporti vjetor inspektimi

candidates.source_name: BSPK — Bashkimi i Sindikatave të Pavarura të Kosovës (Confederation of Independent Trade Unions of Kosovo)
candidates.why_relevant: Kosovo's only ITUC-member union confederation and umbrella for ~20+ branch unions. Statements, press releases and its private-sector affiliate's campaigns are the main organised-labour channel where dismissals, wage disputes and anti-union retaliation in private employers (including banks) surface.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/news-page scrape plus member-union directory extraction (snowball into any financial-sector affiliate); monitor Facebook page for faster-moving statements.
queries_used: BSPK Bashkimi i Sindikatave të Pavarura të Kosovës sindikata sektori privat bankë
local_language_terms_used: Bashkimi i Sindikatave të Pavarura të Kosovës

candidates.source_name: Sindikata e Pavarur e Sektorit Privat të Kosovës (Independent Union of the Private Sector, led by Jusuf Azemi) — via BSPK and media
candidates.why_relevant: The private-sector union is the only organised labour actor plausibly covering bank employees (there is effectively no dedicated bank-workers' union in Kosovo). Its leader's strike threats and complaint statements are carried by economic media; the 'grevë' tag page is a practical aggregation point for strike signals.
candidates.source_subtype: union spokesperson coverage / media tag feed
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Tag-page polling + named-entity alerting on 'Azemi', 'sindikata e sektorit privat', bank names.
queries_used: "sindikata" Kosovë sektori financiar bankar grevë punëtorët bankë 2025
S'ka sindikata në sektorin privat

candidates.source_name: APRK — Agjencia e Punësimit e Republikës së Kosovës (Employment Agency)
candidates.why_relevant: Public employment service administering registered jobseekers, vacancies and active labour-market measures. Registration inflows and vacancy postings by economic activity are the administrative trace of financial-sector layoffs and hiring waves; the agency is also the notification counterparty for collective redundancy procedures.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape vacancy listings and periodic statistical bulletins; monitor Facebook page (APRKosova) for faster announcements.
queries_used: Agjencia e Punësimit e Republikës së Kosovës APRK statistikat e tregut të punës

candidates.source_name: SITP — Barometri i Tregut të Punës në Kosovë (Kosovo Labour Market Barometer / Employment Module)
candidates.why_relevant: Administrative-data labour-market dashboard combining Civil Registry, Tax Administration, MFLT and APRK records, with breakdowns by economic activity and occupation. This is the closest thing to a machine-readable series for headcount movement in the financial-activities NACE class — the strongest quantitative early-warning input for this cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Inspect dashboard XHR/API endpoints for JSON series; if none, periodic filtered exports for NACE K (financial and insurance activities).
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search snowball from APRK query
queries_used: Agjencia e Punësimit e Republikës së Kosovës APRK statistikat e tregut të punës

candidates.source_name: ASK — Agjencia e Statistikave të Kosovës (Kosovo Agency of Statistics), Labour Force Survey and business statistics
candidates.why_relevant: Official statistics producer: Anketa e Fuqisë Punëtore (LFS), registered-employment and structural business statistics by activity. Provides the denominator against which financial-sector headcount changes are judged, and its API host (askapi.rks-gov.net) serves publication files directly.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest LFS quarterly/annual PDFs and any open-data/askapi endpoints; extract employment by NACE section K.
queries_used: Agjencia e Punësimit e Republikës së Kosovës APRK statistikat e tregut të punës

candidates.source_name: Gjykata Themelore në Prishtinë — published judgments (labour and commercial departments)
candidates.why_relevant: Kosovo courts publish anonymised judgments as PDFs, including 'kontest pune' (employment disputes) and Economic Department cases involving banks. Wrongful-dismissal and severance judgments naming bank defendants are a hard, citable record of workforce conflict and restructuring.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl verdict listing pages, download PDFs, OCR/text-extract and keyword filter on bank names + 'marrëdhënie pune', 'ndërprerje e kontratës'.

candidates.why_relevant: Central entry point to all Basic Courts, the Court of Appeals and their verdict repositories, plus caseload statistics including employment-dispute backlogs. Pointer for expanding judicial collection beyond Prishtina to Prizren, Peja, Gjilan, Mitrovica.

candidates.source_name: ARBK — Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve (Kosovo Business Registration Agency) public register
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory registry of companies, foreign-company branches and registered changes (directors, authorised persons, branch openings/closures, capital). Registered changes to bank legal entities and branch units are the legally-mandated paper trail behind organisation changes and leadership moves that banks do not announce.
candidates.access_status: public search (some services behind eKosova login)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic entity lookups for each licensed bank and its branch units; diff registered directors/authorised persons and branch records over time.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated bank-workers' or financial-sector trade union was found for Kosovo in Albanian or Serbian searches. Searches for 'sindikata e punëtorëve bankarë' and 'sindikat bankarskih radnika Kosovo' returned no such organisation, only general private-sector union coverage and individual dismissal cases.
negative_findings.result_summary: Grievance signal for banks is not channelled through a sectoral union; it appears via the Labour Inspectorate, courts, individual complainants and media instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design for this cell must not wait on a bank union feed that does not exist; the inspectorate/court/registry path is the load-bearing one.

negative_findings.description: No public dataset or register of collective-redundancy notifications ('largime kolektive') filed by employers in Kosovo was located; the Labour Inspectorate publishes aggregate inspection statistics and ad-hoc notices, not case-level or employer-level redundancy filings.
negative_findings.result_summary: Employer-level redundancy events must be reconstructed from complaints, judgments, registry changes and media rather than read off a register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets expectations for coverage: the cell yields case-level anecdotes plus aggregate statistics, not a clean event feed.

negative_findings.description: Multiple independent sources (CSO monitoring reports, RFE/RL, news coverage) describe the Labour Inspectorate as under-resourced (~53 inspectors nationwide) and limited in transparency, with a documented nine-month delay against a statutory 30-day deadline in the ProCredit Bank complaints.
negative_findings.result_summary: Inspectorate output lags events substantially and is incomplete, especially for the private sector.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Timeliness assumptions for inspectorate-derived signals must be measured in quarters, not weeks; media and registry sources will usually lead it.

negative_findings.description: Employee-review platforms (Glassdoor) carry Kosovo-filtered content for at least Raiffeisen Bank International, but their terms prohibit automated collection and review lists are partly gated. No Kosovo-specific coverage was found on any local employer-review platform; none appears to exist.
negative_findings.result_summary: Review-site signal is usable only manually or under licence, and only for the international bank groups.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Constrains what would otherwise be the fastest sentiment/attrition indicator for this cell.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language searching produced rich results for bank branch closures and staff redundancies in the north and enclaves (NLB Komercijalna: branch plus nine outlets, 38 employees affected, severance/voluntary-departure programmes) but produced no Serbian-language union actor specific to Kosovo bank employees; affected staff appealed to Serbian government bodies rather than to a union.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian-language coverage is essential for branch-closure/redundancy signals but has no union pointer of its own.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms sr-language monitoring of KoSSev/Radio KIM/Kontakt Plus is mandatory, and that the grievance route in the north is political rather than union-mediated.

negative_findings.description: The SITP labour-market barometer (sitp.rks-gov.net) and KosovaJob were identified but not fetched in this run, so their export/API capability and terms of use are unconfirmed. Neither should be recorded as live or as machine-collectable until the deterministic verification pass runs.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two high-value candidates carry lower confidence pending verification.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-promising a structured financial-sector headcount series that may only exist as an on-screen dashboard.

coverage_gaps.description: BSPK's member-union directory was not enumerated, so it is unconfirmed whether any affiliate covers financial services (e.g. a services or commerce union that banks would fall under).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch bspk.org member-union list and each affiliate's contact page; snowball on any services/commerce/finance affiliate and its officials' names.

coverage_gaps.description: Court judgment repositories were identified but not searched for bank defendants in employment disputes; per-court coverage beyond Prishtina (Prizren, Peja, Gjilan, Ferizaj, Mitrovica, Gjakova) is unmapped, as is the Court of Appeals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate all Basic Court subdomains on gjyqesori-rks.org, harvest verdict PDFs, and build a keyword index on the ten licensed banks plus 'kontest pune'.

coverage_gaps.description: No baseline snapshot of ARBK records for each licensed bank and its registered branch units was taken, so branch-closure and authorised-person changes cannot yet be detected by diffing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Take an initial ARBK snapshot per bank entity (directors, authorised persons, registered units) and schedule monthly diffs; check whether eKosova login is required for full extracts.

coverage_gaps.description: Employee-voice channels beyond Glassdoor were not surveyed: LinkedIn departure/tenure signals, local Facebook groups where dismissed Kosovo bank staff discuss cases, and any Albanian-language forum equivalents.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Survey LinkedIn company pages of Kosovo banks for headcount and departure patterns, and identify the main Albanian-language employment/complaint Facebook groups; assess terms and feasibility for each.

coverage_gaps.description: The specific Labour Law provisions and administrative instructions governing collective redundancy thresholds and mandatory notification to the Labour Inspectorate and APRK were not retrieved, so the trigger conditions that would make a bank restructuring officially visible are unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Retrieve the Labour Law and relevant administrative instructions from gzk.rks-gov.net and extract notification thresholds, deadlines and recipient institutions.

coverage_gaps.description: APRK and SITP were identified but not queried at the NACE-K (financial and insurance activities) level; it is unconfirmed whether their published breakdowns go deep enough to isolate banking headcount and jobseeker inflows.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query SITP and APRK bulletins for financial-activity breakdowns; if unavailable publicly, prepare an official information request to APRK/ASK.

coverage_gaps.description: International labour-rights monitors that document Kosovo (ITUC Global Rights Index, ILO country pages, European Commission Kosovo Report labour chapter) were not searched in this run and may carry systematic assessments of anti-union practice relevant to bank employers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search ITUC, ILO and EC enlargement-report sources for Kosovo labour-rights and social-dialogue findings; add as credibility anchors.

brief: Kosovo's labour-side signal for banking is institutionally thin but not absent: there is no bank-workers' union, so grievances surface through the Labour Inspectorate (ip.rks-gov.net), published court judgments, the ARBK business registry and investigative media (KALLXO, Preportr), with BSPK and its private-sector affiliate as the only organised-labour voice. The strongest documented cases in this cell came from exactly these channels — ProCredit Bank dismissal complaints that the Inspectorate upheld after a nine-month delay, and the NLB Komercijalna withdrawal that closed a branch plus nine outlets and put 38 staff into severance programmes. Serbian-language monitoring is mandatory rather than optional: the branch-closure and redundancy detail for the north and the enclaves exists only on KoSSev, Radio KIM and Kontakt Plus. Quantitative validation should anchor on BQK branch and headcount tables and, if their granularity holds up, the SITP administrative-data barometer and APRK; employee-review platforms carry real Kosovo-filtered signal but are terms-restricted and must be treated as manual or licensed.
